mechanism_narrative: The sustained and accelerating decline in RETAIL_REC over the past four weeks indicates a strong negative momentum that will persist, leading to further decreases in retail and recreation activity over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in WORKPLACES mobility, exceeding a 20-point drop week-on-week, signifies severe restrictions on non-essential work, which directly reduces retail and recreation opportunities over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls by more than 20 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days does not decrease further despite WORKPLACES falling by more than 20 points week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: The simultaneous increase in RESIDENTIAL mobility and sharp decrease in WORKPLACES mobility indicates a population shift towards staying at home and away from commercial areas, severely impacting retail and recreation over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days increases while RESIDENTIAL mobility remains elevated and WORKPLACES mobility remains depressed.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in TRANSIT station activity, particularly when below -30% from baseline, reflects significant public transport restrictions or reduced demand due to lockdown, directly limiting access to retail and recreation over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days rises despite TRANSIT remaining below -30% from baseline.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in GROCERY_PHARM mobility, falling below -10% from baseline, suggests a broader reduction in essential outings, which will inevitably drag down non-essential retail and recreation over the next week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days increases or stabilizes despite GROCERY_PHARM falling below -10% from baseline.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in PARKS mobility while RETAIL_REC continues to fall indicates a substitution effect where people seek outdoor, non-commercial recreation options under lockdown, diverting activity away from retail over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS mobility is above 50% while RETAIL_REC is below -20%
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days increases while PARKS mobility remains high and RETAIL_REC remains low.

mechanism_narrative: The broad-based decline across RETAIL_REC, GROCERY_PHARM, TRANSIT, and WORKPLACES, coupled with rising RESIDENTIAL mobility, signifies a comprehensive reduction in out-of-home activity that will continue to depress retail and recreation over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: The mean of RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than the mean of the last 28 days, despite the broad decline observed across multiple categories.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in RESIDENTIAL mobility, particularly when above 4% from baseline, indicates strict stay-at-home orders are in effect, which directly suppresses all non-essential out-of-home activities including retail and recreation over the next week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days increases while RESIDENTIAL mobility remains above 4% from baseline.
